programme.title: Toolkit delivery and operational assurance
programme.objective: Complete the required Toolkit outcomes under the accepted north-star architecture while reducing routine context, orchestration and model-call cost without weakening safety, correctness, recoverability or evidence.
boundaries: G3 implementation and validation remain bounded to the accepted successor contract.
holds: G4 and Web finality remain separate transitions.
programme.next_action: Validate the exact successor candidate before any Web G4 adjudication.

C1.title: Controller Kernel + Delivery Contract
C1.complete_when: The successor contract passes bounded G3 validation and is accepted at the Web finality boundary.

C2.title: Child-Owned Programme State + Obligation Continuity
C2.complete_when: Child-owned programme state is transferred with criterion-level obligation continuity and source-backed evidence.

C3.title: Published Capability Conformance
C3.complete_when: Published capabilities conform to the accepted controller and programme contracts.

S1.title: Managed Setup Execution Safety
S1.complete_when: Managed setup execution preserves bounded transport, cleanup, cancellation, exit-code and privacy semantics.

S2.title: Managed Configuration Recovery
S2.complete_when: Managed configuration recovery is source-bound, reversible and verified without manufacturing authority.

H1.title: Native Delivery - Codex
H1.complete_when: Codex native delivery is qualified under the registered host and completion contract.

H2.title: Native Delivery - Claude Code
H2.complete_when: Claude Code native delivery is qualified under the registered host and completion contract.

H3.title: Native Delivery - OpenCode
H3.complete_when: OpenCode native delivery is qualified under the registered host and completion contract.

H4.title: AG2 Skills-Only Qualification
H4.complete_when: AG2 skills-only qualification is verified without introducing an unsupported execution path.

W1.title: Source-Watch Conformance
W1.complete_when: Source-watch behavior remains notification-only, pinned and approval-bound.

W2.title: Workspace Safety and Lifecycle
W2.complete_when: Workspace lifecycle and isolation controls are verified before consequential concurrency.

D1.title: Evidence-Driven Debugging + Fresh Verification
D1.complete_when: Debugging and verification use fresh bounded evidence with truthful readiness conclusions.

A1.title: Exact Route Resolution
A1.complete_when: Authoritative route identity is provider/model/reasoning plus exact stack/registry/stage/thread provenance; service treatment (tier, priority, standard, default or equivalent provider execution class) is non-authoritative and excluded from route selection, route digests, admission, stored-route checks, prompt requirements, gate contracts and correctness/finality claims; observed treatment is diagnostic-only with explicit provenance, and A2 consumes the tier-free route contract.

A2.title: Repository Loop Manager + Durable Child Execution + Metering
A2.complete_when: Durable child execution and metering preserve terminal delivery, identity and bounded resource accounting.

A3.title: Concurrent Loop Execution + Integration
A3.complete_when: Concurrent execution and integration are admitted only after workspace safety and independent-path proof.

A4.title: Trusted CI Publication
A4.complete_when: Trusted CI publishes the exact validation union with unique contexts and deterministic aggregation.

A5.title: Repository Protection Reconciliation
A5.complete_when: Repository protection mechanically matches Controller finality and rejects pending or failing required lanes.

N1.title: Official n8n Dependency Admission
N1.complete_when: Official n8n dependencies are admitted only with verified source and safety provenance.

N2.title: Offline n8n Workflow Handling
N2.complete_when: Offline workflow handling validates and transports workflow artifacts without live mutation.

N3.title: Authorized n8n API Transport
N3.complete_when: n8n API transport remains explicitly authorized, bounded and auditable.

X1.title: Secret References + Private Custody
X1.complete_when: Secret references and private custody remain outside public projections and repository artifacts.

X2.title: Sensitive-File Access Guard
X2.complete_when: Sensitive-file access is guarded by explicit scope, provenance and fail-closed checks.

X3.title: External Operation Authority
X3.complete_when: External operations require current-turn authority for the named target and operation.

X4.title: Privacy-Safe Operational Evidence
X4.complete_when: Operational evidence remains privacy-minimized, support-safe and source-traceable.

X5.title: Hosted Monitoring and Reporting
X5.complete_when: Hosted monitoring and reporting expose only truthful, authorized state transitions.

X6.title: Hosted Recovery and Disaster Recovery
X6.complete_when: Hosted recovery and disaster recovery are tested, bounded and reversible.

X7.title: SHA-Bound Deployment and Health
X7.complete_when: Deployment and health verification remain bound to the exact accepted revision and rollback evidence.

V1.title: Integrated Conformance + UAT
V1.complete_when: Integrated conformance and UAT accept every required outcome and unresolved hold.

V2.title: Whole-Programme Final Audit
V2.complete_when: The whole programme passes final audit and exact Web finality is accepted after readback.

Q.title: Continuing Improvement Queue
Q.complete_when: The deferred queue remains non-executing and retains parent-owned continuing-improvement obligations.
